sections.heading: Overview

sections.content: TfNSW's objective for the project are to improve safety on Appin Road between Mount Gilead and Brian Road in Appin. The project will create safer travel conditions for road users by adding wider lanes and shoulders, while also implementing key measures to protect wildlife.
sections.heading: Project goals

sections.content: Tenders are invited from pre-qualified contractors with Transport for NSW under the National Prequalification Scheme at Roadworks Category R3 (or higher), Bridgeworks Category B1 (or higher) and Financial Level F75 (or higher) to deliver the construction of road safety improvement along Appin Road between Appin and Gilead. This construction work consists of road realignment, road and shoulders widening and installation of fauna exclusion infrastructure. Additional information on the Project is available on the TfNSW website: https://www.transport.nsw.gov.au/projects/current-projects/appin-road-safety-improvements.
sections.heading: Scope

sections.content:
A pre-tender meeting will be held at 10:00am on Thursday, 6 August 2026 on Microsoft Teams. Prospective Tenderers must register at least 2 days prior with the Contact Officer.
An initial site visit will be held at 10:00 am on Friday, 7 August 2026 at the southwest corner of Brian Road and Appin Road in Appin. Prospective Tenderers must register at least 2 days prior with the Contact Officer.
Attendance is not mandatory to the pre-tender meeting and initial site visit to submit a conforming submission.
Prospective tenderers will need to complete, sign and return the confidentiality deed) in accordance with the instructions in that deed) prior to being given the access the Request for Tender documents.
